selection_rules.order: Inspect every listed discovery scene in fixed order, no early stopping or replacement; keep zero/failed records. No output-based addition of scenes.
selection_rules.eligibility: For each new arm independently, first discovery scene in listed order with >=1 actual veto and >=1 veto frame on that arm own full continuous history; all three complete canonical-prediction/full-trace/count repeats identical. Reference hypothetical exposure does not qualify. One frame establishes mechanism exposure only.
selection_rules.forbidden: Do not load GT/labels/evaluator, FP/FN/IDSW/Identity/HOTA, accuracy-based scene ranking or manually favourable clips. Do not adjust parameters, equivalence tolerance, frame sampling, classes/resolution/confidence or buffer.
selection_rules.negative: No qualifying scene yields null selection; do not loosen thresholds or relabel zeros as success. Failure remains in ledger and prevents a complete confirmation claim.
selection_rules.confirmation: Before any confirmation tracker output, seal complete discovery JSON hash and deterministic selections. Then run all three frozen arms on BOTH reserved full sequences regardless discovery outcome, without additional selection. Do not use confirmation as a discovery replacement. A trigger seen first only in confirmation is not independently replicated discovery.
selection_rules.replication_gate: Report each reserved scene. An arm has exposure replicated only if discovery found a qualifying scene and the arm actually vetoes in both reserved scenes with three equal repeats and no failures. Exposure is NOT accuracy, correctness, physical ID ownership or release acceptance.
selection_rules.independence: Discovery/confirmation sequence IDs and declared official-description source families disjoint. Shared dataset/detector/runtime and non-random group choice limit independence; no claim of independent datasets, camera sites or participants.

execution.source: Use every decoded source frame from complete official compressed previews, no resampling/cropping or re-encoding.
execution.shards: Each detection JSON respects unchanged <=1800 frames / <=64 detections per frame / <=32MiB contract. Explicit contiguous source_start_frame. One tracker/AssociationProbe and continuous source index per full video, retained across shards; no reset at boundary.
execution.weak_continuation: Original >=.1 weak detection inputs, active weak continuation and uncontested recovery retained. Controls unchanged, no app/worker registration or default changes.
execution.order: Fresh tracker per arm/repeat, 3 arms rotated 0/1/2 per repeat, OpenCV seed0/one thread. Additional canonical/complete-trace hashes, no throughput claim.
execution.gt_separation: Input schema permits only source video/cache paths and hashes. No GT key. All discovery and confirmation runners have no accuracy evaluator and perform no scoring.

limitations: Finite prespecified public-preview cohort; cannot promise a scene satisfying the unchanged exact-equivalence rule exists.
Known-scene GT outcomes were seen historically, so those scenes serve discovery only. Current selection uses no GT scores.
Confirmation tests exposure repeatability, not FN/FP/IDSW/HOTA or physical identity correctness. No default or release acceptance.
Detector caps/compression/camera motion/source-family overlap may limit exposure; report every inspected source and cap count.
Original cases/matrices/IDs/media stay local. Only protocol, complete per-sequence count/hash ledger and numeric plots are public.
